title: Gallstone pancreatitis, home; diagnosis only in CM note, med list only in nursing, pending result only in a progress note

rationale.final_diagnosis: The summary's 'Principal Diagnosis' section only says 'Refer to case management note'; the diagnosis appears only in the CM note, which this rule does not accept.
rationale.discharge_meds: 'Discharge Medications: As per nursing discharge instructions' is a cross-reference, not a list; the list exists only in the nursing document, which this rule does not accept.
rationale.pending_results: The pending CBD brushing cytology and its owner appear only in a progress note; the discharge summary never addresses pending results.
rationale.meds_consistent: The summary has no medication list, so every nursing medication (including acetaminophen and lisinopril, which the summary never mentions) is absent from the summary.
rationale.med_changes: The summary's Medication Changes section states what was started and stopped, independent of the missing full list.
rationale.pac_list: Home without services, so the post-acute rules do not apply.
